rules: Small sheep wait behind the forest in authored inter-column lanes. Their corridor is clear only if no burning tree lies within 1.05 arena units of the route to the front refuge.

Once clear, sheep run at 1.25 arena units/second, queue behind others in the same lane, and celebrate for 1.15 seconds before awarding coins exactly once. Arrival shows a gold coin and uses the existing rescue chime.

Only nearby burning trees (radius 1.9 arena units) damage sheep. Initial grace period: 8 seconds. Hidden health starts at 1, damage is 0.012/second per threat, capped at two threats. No health bars or animal interaction UI.

Direct water impacts and splash protect sheep through the same production water-impact route as fire. Wetness lasts at most 6 seconds and blocks damage; water restores a small amount of health. Invalid/negative samples cannot grant protection or rewards.
Zero health means Lost. Lost sheep shrink away with a brief topple; no blood or repeated distress audio. Lost animals never pay and cannot be revived for currency.

Tree suppression grants score/combo but no cash. Retain base clear reward 25*(stage+1) and cabin reward. Fully rescued first sector yields 100 coins; ideal first-three-sector income permits all three additional tools with 185 coins left.
Pause/focus loss and shop input retain existing simulation suspension. Retry rewinds entry money and rebuilds sheep; lost-stage simulation cannot grant new animal rewards.
Next sector or camp departure after containment safely evacuates any remaining living sheep and pays each once, so skipping their final animation never loses earned money.
art: Original procedural sheep: cream scalloped wool, cocoa faces, white eyes with highlights, rosy cheeks, pink ear interiors and rounded hooves. Shared vertex-colour meshes and one simple instanced toon material; no rigidbodies, colliders, health bars or NavMesh agents.

Domain-clock animation: idle breathing/head movement, frightened tremble and drooping ears, water-induced head/body shake, alternating running legs and bounce, happy arrival jump, retreat/failure shrink and spinning rising coin.

Cartoon sky replaces the photographic panorama: blue/mint gradient, six rounded cloud groups with cream tops, layered green hills. Retain the world-oriented spherical sky, subject-centred circular coverage, 12-degree feather, transparent exterior, stereo macros and upward reveal.
Original Poly Haven photo is archived at Assets/FireRescue/ArtV2/EmberdeepSky-Photographic.jpg outside Resources, preserving its GUID and CC0 provenance without shipping the unused sky texture.
grab_changes: Pickup requires stable physical proximity and closure for 100 ms; an already closed hand can approach slowly without a fresh-grasp deadline. Pickup itself never fires.
A deliberate closed-hand contact on the rack tool now wins over a menu ray even before pickup; open-hand distant menus retain their prior policy.
Broaden extinguisher top/shoulder acquisition; gold carrying handle and cyan nozzle sleeve identify the two functional contacts. Lower body remains carry-only.
Remove stale PINCH GRIP rack instruction. If a tightly closed pickup has not armed firing, explicitly ask the primary hand to relax once then squeeze, while preserving tool ownership.
Retain 0.2.20 mirrored nozzle direction, slow nozzle acquisition, nearby-tool UI priority, body-to-top regrip, primary hand transfer and explicit rack return.
preview_scope: Unity rendered frames. Portrait is injected animation sampling; rescue capture uses live game frames with scripted suppression. Not headset footage.
